input.summary: Insert post-termination transition assistance, data/materials return within 30 days, and certified deletion into Section 6.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 6 addresses fees and Works in progress but says nothing about transition help or getting our data and Confidential Information back, so we added a standard exit clause: up to six months of transition assistance at Contractor's then-current rates, return of our data in a machine-readable format within thirty days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept ninety days of assistance provided the thirty-day return and deletion certificate stay.

ops.text: (d) Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Statement of Work for any reason, Contractor shall (i) at Company's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Contractor's then-current rates; (ii) within thirty (30) days of such expiry or termination, return to Company all Works, Company data and Confidential Information in Contractor's possession or control in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (iii) thereafter delete all such data and Confidential Information from its systems and certify such deletion to Company in writing.
